headline: Presidential order adjusting pay rates for certain federal government jobs, likely for the year 2016.
what_it_does: This executive order adjusts certain rates of pay set by the federal government. Orders with this title are usually issued each December to set the coming year's pay schedules for federal workers. No summary was provided, so the exact pay changes and which jobs are covered cannot be confirmed from the source material.

who_it_affects.how: Their pay rates may be adjusted under the schedules set by this order.
